articles.author: ROD McGUIRK — Associated Press
articles.title: Shark kills swimmer off Western Australian city beach - WRAL
articles.description: MELBOURNE, Australia (AP) — A man was killed by a shark as he swam off a Western Australian city beach Friday while beachgoers watched in horror.
